answer: Randomized Delay Gate. Each new agent identity must wait for a delay drawn from a verifiable random function seeded by a public beacon the attacker cannot predict before commit. The ripple of admission slots spreads across epochs, so mass registration cannot front-run the draw. Every identity pays the real cost of idle capital and monitoring through its timber wait, and a fake fleet must sustain that cost across the whole voyage of onboarding. Attacker cost scales linearly with identities and cannot be precomputed.
